credits_spent: free plan, Google sign-in; one prompt, three designs offered
failures: P1: The name is right and the logo is the studio's, but there is no tagline. The hero holds the name, the navigation and one photograph; the brief's one-line tagline never appears.
P2: The photo gallery holds six images, not nine. Home adds five more, so the site has eleven photographs in total, but the gallery page itself stops at six.

P5: /contact exists with copy that says 'Send us a message using the form', and there is no form. The generator had built a SimplyBook.me booking block; publishing warned that it is a premium plugin and dropped it.
P7: The gallery images are served at 390x390 and there is no viewer: clicking a photograph does nothing, nothing is linked. Only the two large home photographs come at 975 to 1300 px.
P20: No image on any page carries alt text (18 of 18 without), so alt text is missing throughout.
notes: Webnode's AI takes the brief on a single page, offers three generated designs, and after selecting one it goes straight into the editor with seven pages: Home, Photo gallery, Harbour Light, Interiors, Quiet Portraits, About and Contact. The copy is written well — the series pages explain each body of work, the about page has three paragraphs, all in English. Sign-in runs through Google and the free site publishes on a webnode.page subdomain with a fixed blue banner ('This website was made with Webnode'). The generator had inserted a SimplyBook.me booking block; at publish time Webnode warned that booking needs the paid plugin, so we published without it — which is why the contact page ended up as text without a form. Photographs come from Pexels, credited in the footer. Lighthouse mobile performance 91, but SEO 61.

artifacts.label: Contact page: copy promises a form, no form there
